subject: Stuck - export_png on Windows, Node.JS config issue?

messages.author: f562cc721b7e9a13
messages.subject: Stuck - export_png on Windows, Node.JS config issue?
parts:
Has anyone gotten export_png working on Windows?  I have Node.JS installed and added the Vega package but have not seen success with export_png.  I must have missed a Node.JS config step, based on the thrown errors.

Another route?  Python?

Thanks in advance,
Stephen



library("ggvis")

mtcars %>%
  ggvis(x=~hp, y=~mpg) %>%
  export_png()



Writing to file plot.png

 Show Traceback

 

 Rerun with Debug

 

Error in vega_file(vis, file = file, type = "png")

Conversion program vg2pngnot found

messages.author: f562cc721b7e9a13
messages.subject: Re: Stuck - export_png on Windows, Node.JS config issue?
parts:
Hi Hadley,

I've spent about 8 hours on numerous Windows 8.1 x64 issues related to canvas, vega and npm (there appears to be numerous problems in the 8.1 world.)  I never managed to use Vega headless to create png files, so I shelved this work and moved to my Ubuntu server.

On Ubuntu, I have installed everything required to run the headless Vega examples and create png files from their examples.  For example, I can run this and receive a nice png file.
v2png /home/ubuntu/node_modules/vega/examples/spec/bar.json bar.png

Unfortunately, running R in the same session with the mtcars example results in this error:
Error: is.ggvis(x = x) is not TRUE

Thanks,
Stephen

messages.subject: Re: Stuck - export_png on Windows, Node.JS config issue?
parts:
Hi Hadley,

I resolved the issue on Ubuntu by upgrading ggvis to 0.4.  I only realized that I had updated my Windows ggvis to 0.4 after sending the last reply.  Sorry!

At some point in the future, I will return to the Windows problem, but please consider this resolved for now.

Thanks,
Stephen
